reply_text: The depot is Southgate. In the #inc-tansley-carrier-api log from Sept 3, 2025, Priyanka reported that label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch holding totes stacked by door 4. Southgate cleared the backlog and labels were printing again by 18:43 that day. I posted that in the channel as a reply to you.
